thread:
maya: Quick sync — I posted a draft hybrid canary/A-B plan for the multi-tenant upload. Need fast feedback on three items: tenant pin window, experiment/sample cadence, and rollback gates. Short thread, please react with :eyes: or reply.
jorge: thanks — can you paste the TL;DR numbers? want to validate against SLAs before we commit.
maya: TL;DR: sample 5% of traffic initially (random tenant sampling), tenant pin window = 6h by default (opt-in 24h for heavy customers), staged ramp: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 3 hours each, rollback if 1) error rate doubles vs baseline for 5m, or 2) p50 latency increases >150ms sustained 10m, or 3) automated quality eval drop >3% on our seed prompts. Fallback routing: route to last stable variant in same region, then to cheaper small-llm if capacity exhausted.
sarah: 6h pin window feels short for some enterprise customers. suggestion: make pin window configurable per-customer with guardrails — e.g., max pin = 72h but requires Ops approval and a pinned-token flag.
alex: +1 on configurable pin. also: need to call out model-variant compatibility rules — you can't fall back from fp16 to int4 without a regen policy for deterministic outputs. propose model-compat table in PRD.
emily: Customer asks: if they request dedicated capacity mid-rollout, what's the handoff? We should add acceptance criteria for "mid-rollout dedicated promotion" — automated drain from canary pool + warmup to dedicated for pinned tenants.
maya: good call. add to PRD: "mid-rollout dedicated promotion" MUST complete warmup in <15m for 90% of requests or rollback promotion.
jorge: about metrics — define baseline windows. propose baseline = 7d median for latency, and 24h rolling for error rate. also we should tag all canary traffic in telemetry with experiment_id + tenant_id for quick slices.
chen: config sketch for rollout rules:

```
rollout:
  id: exp-2026-11-multi-tenant-hybrid
  phases:
    - sample_pct: 5
      duration: 3h
    - sample_pct: 20
      duration: 3h
    - sample_pct: 50
      duration: 6h
  pin:
    default_hours: 6
    max_hours: 72
  rollback_gates:
    - err_rate_relative: 2.0
      window: 5m
    - p50_latency_ms_rel: 150
      window: 10m
    - quality_drop_percent: 3
      window: realtime
```

chen: this is just a sketch — we should validate windows with SRE.
maya: note re: telemetry tagging — ensure PIIs excluded in tenant_id tags; use hashed id.
alex: experiment design question — do we randomize at request-level or tenant-level? mixing both complicates metrics. recommend tenant-level for first two phases, then request-level mixing when at 50%.
sarah: agree. tenant-level reduces noisy churn for small customers. add acceptance criteria: experiment should include at least 20 medium+ tenants to validate throughput changes.
emily: ops question: what if a high-profile customer is in the 5% sample and complains? should we provide a fast opt-out API for their tenant? suggest an immediate unpin endpoint and an SLA to respond within 15m.
maya: add to playbook: "customer-opt-out API" + human escalation path (oncall -> PM -> AE). document in launch checklist.
deploy-bot: [automation] note: draft experiment config saved at infra/experiments/exp-2026-11-multi-tenant-hybrid.yaml
jorge: next steps: I'll surface required telemetry slices and add the metric thresholds to the PRD. Sarah, can you own the pin config UI language? Emily, can you draft the mid-rollout promotion sequence for Dedicated?
sarah: can do. will also add the wording for approval flows and Ops ACLs.
emily: on it. I'll mock the API call sequence and SLA doc — will post by EOD.
maya: thanks all. I'll fold these into the PRD and ping legal for the pin-duration customer T&Cs. please react with :thumbsup: when done or drop comments inline in the PRD doc.
